about: David J. Drez III is an attorney who represents clients in the Fort Worth, Texas area. David Drez III is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Drez III chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law and graduated in 1998. David Drez III passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1998.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Energy & Natural Resources issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Drez III has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
